findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation "Raise the contrast ratio of the flagged text and its background" references only a WCAG criterion without any selector, page URL or design token reference – it can be copy‑pasted into any audit.
Priority 2 recommendation to add alt text mentions only images in general; no specific image selectors, URLs or CMS fields are cited.
Priority 3 recommendation "Order headings without skipping levels" is a generic instruction on heading structure with no target page or selector.
Priority 4 recommendation to wrap primary content in <main> provides only a high‑level directive, lacking any page URL or element reference.
Priority 5 recommendation to replace landmark containers with semantic elements gives no specific selectors or page context – it is a generic best‑practice statement.
Priority 7 recommendation to add missing Schema.org properties references only the entity type, not any specific JSON‑LD instance or selector.
Priority 8 recommendation mirrors Priority 7 – it names required properties but provides no concrete data anchor from this audit.
Optional Enhancements section lists generic patterns (e.g., adding sameAs, potentialAction) without tying them to any specific entity or page in the audited site.
